body: Root cause: cmdSetJob/cmdSetSubJob only mutated in-memory player state, never IDUNA's job_main/job_sub -- any fresh session (relaunch, idle-eviction, service restart) silently reverted to whichever job the character was created with. Compounded by getOrCreateHeadlessPlayer hardcoding every new headless session to WAR L1 regardless of IDUNA's real record. Fixed both: new IDUNA PATCH /api/v1/characters/:id/job (agent-only), idunaclient.UpdateJob wired into both job-change command paths, headless session creation now seeds jobID/charJob/HP/MP from the real persisted job. Live-verified end to end: setjob BLM -> service restart forcing a truly fresh session -> status showed real [BLM] HP/MP, not WAR defaults -> relaunched GUI client, traveled to Meadow, pressed 1, screenshot confirmed a real FIRE cast bar filling instead of an instant melee attack. go test ./... clean in both repos. IDUNA 63e6b6e, GoblinFoxDragon a471599.
title: Fixed: 1/2/3 ability hotkeys not matching real spells in Meadow (job never persisted to IDUNA)
